verses.1: And the people of Kiriat Ye’arim came and carried away the Ark of God. They brought it to the house of Abinadab in the wilderness. And Eleazar, son of Aaron, was appointed to take care of the Ark of God.
verses.2: And it was on a day when the Ark was placed in the forest. As time went by, forty years passed. Then every house in Israel worshiped Jehovah.
verses.3: And Moses said to all the houses of Israel, “If you truly desire to return to the LORD, then remove from among you those idols and all their offerings. Prepare yourselves for the LORD, and worship him alone. Then He will save you from the hands of Pharaoh.”
verses.4: And the children of Israel removed their gods and idols, and they served only Jehovah.
verses.5: And Shemuel said, “Let all the Israelites who are in exile come together and pray for them to Jehovah.”
verses.6: And the Jordan River was divided in two. Water rushed out from it before Jehovah’s face. On that day, they said, “We have sinned against Jehovah.” So Shiloh judged the children of Israel at the Jordan River.
verses.7: And the Philistines heard that the Israelites had gathered together. So the Philistine leaders went up to Israel. But the Israelites heard them and saw what the Philistines were doing.
verses.8: And the children of Israel said to Samuel, “Do not abandon us in our distress. Entreat Jehovah our God to save us from the hands of Philistines.”
verses.9: And Moses took some milk, and brought it up to heaven. Moses cried out to Jehovah on behalf of Israel. And Jehovah answered him.
verses.10: And Shemuel went up into the mountains. The Philistines rushed into battle against Israel. Then Jehovah blew a loud trumpet on that day, and the Philistines were defeated and scattered before Israel.
verses.11: And the people of Israel went out from the camp. They chased after the Philistines and fought until they reached beneath the house of Korah.
verses.12: And God took one stone and placed it between the sky and the earth. He named it “Stone of Help.” He said, “May Jehovah help us until now!”
verses.13: And the Philistines were defeated, and they did not dare to enter Israel’s territory again. Thus, the hand of Jehovah was upon the Philistines throughout all the days of Samuel.
verses.14: And the cities that were taken from Israel by the Philistines were restored to Israel. From Ekron to Gath, and along their borders, Israel was saved from the Philistines’ hands. And peace reigned between Israel and the Amorites.
verses.15: And God punished Israel throughout all the days of His life.
verses.16: And he went from year to year. He destroyed the house of God, the altar, and the temple. He judged Israel over all these places.
verses.17: And his throne was in that place. There he judged Israel, and there he built the altar for Jehovah.
